name: The Plane of Viale Jonio
transport: Montesacro, north Rome; Metro B1 Conca d'Oro, then a short walk, or bus along Via Nomentana
verify_notes: A street-corner London plane in Montesacro, 553cm girth and 32m tall, the second-thickest plane on Rome's monumental tree register after the already-published rom_013. Two independent sources: the national MASAF/Lazio register and a Comune di Roma press notice. Stands about 6km north of the historic centre, within the roughly 30-minute public-transport day-trip boundary via Metro B1.
